ValidationRule.description: This forces users to choose 09 if the status is on 08
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "08 Not Approved, Changes Still Needed"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "09 Not Approved, Changes Made")), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Status 08 requires you to choose "09 Not Approved, Changes Made" as the next status. You can't go backwards at this point.
